guides.definition: A class selector begins with a full stop and matches elements whose class list contains the named token. Classes are reusable and may be combined.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The class token without a leading dot.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A value accepted by the selected property.

examples.title: Pad every card
examples.explanation: Every element with class=card receives one root-em of inner spacing.

guides.definition: Custom property names begin with two hyphens. Their values participate in the cascade and var() substitutes the computed value where it is used.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The custom property name without the leading double hyphen.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The class that consumes the value.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: The property receiving the custom value.

examples.title: Reuse an accent color
examples.explanation: Changing --accent at the root updates every declaration that references it unless a nearer value overrides the cascade.

guides.definition: With box-sizing:border-box, width and height apply to the border box instead of only the content box, simplifying layout calculations.

examples.title: Normalize element sizing
examples.explanation: The universal selector and both generated pseudo-elements use the same predictable sizing model.

guides.definition: A media query condition tests the output environment. Range syntax can express a minimum viewport width without device-specific assumptions.

parameters.name: minimum
parameters.description: The viewport width at which the rule begins to apply.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The class changed by the query.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: The property changed at the breakpoint.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value used when the condition matches.

examples.title: Add a sidebar on wider viewports
examples.explanation: The two-column layout activates when the viewport has enough inline space.

guides.definition: :focus-visible matches a focused element when the user agent's interaction heuristics call for an obvious focus indicator, commonly during keyboard navigation.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The thickness of the focus indicator.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Space between the border and outline.

examples.title: Make button focus obvious
examples.explanation: The indicator remains outside the component border and is not removed from keyboard users.
